items.title: 在职群体参加继续学习的目的
items.en: purposes of continuing education among employees

blocks.v: The bar chart above clearly illustrates how the purposes of continuing education among working people are distributed. Improving current job skills takes the lead, accounting for 65%, followed by learning about new fields and developing personal interests at 48% and 37% respectively, while obtaining qualifications comes last at 26%. Taken together, the three largest items make up 150%.

sents.en: The bar chart above clearly illustrates how the purposes of continuing education among working people are distributed.
sents.cn: 该柱状图清晰地展示了在职群体参加继续教育的目的分布情况。

sents.en: Improving current job skills takes the lead, accounting for 65%, followed by learning about new fields and developing personal interests at 48% and 37% respectively, while obtaining qualifications comes last at 26%.
sents.cn: 提升现有岗位技能遥遥领先，占 65%；其后是学习新领域和发展个人兴趣，分别占 48% 和 37%；而获得文凭位居最后，占 26%。

sents.en: Taken together, the three largest items make up 150%.
sents.cn: 前三项加起来占 150%。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. Primary among these is that advances in technology have made continuing education part of daily life rather than a privilege. Equally important, employers now look for experience as much as for grades. A further driver is that shared online courses have begun to narrow the gap between urban and rural classrooms.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象是多种因素共同作用的结果。

sents.en: Primary among these is that advances in technology have made continuing education part of daily life rather than a privilege.
sents.cn: 首要的是，科技的进步让 继续教育 从少数人的特权变成日常生活的一部分。

sents.en: Equally important, employers now look for experience as much as for grades.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，如今用人单位既看重成绩，也看重经验。

sents.en: A further driver is that shared online courses have begun to narrow the gap between urban and rural classrooms.
sents.cn: 另一个推动因素是，共享网课已经开始缩小城乡课堂之间的差距。

blocks.v: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Clear rules and steady funding matter more than one-off campaigns. Schools can build lifelong learning into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra. Government can fund public facilities so that lifelong learning is not limited to those who can pay. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.

sents.en: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming.
sents.cn: 总体来看，这是一个值得肯定的积极趋势。

sents.en: Clear rules and steady funding matter more than one-off campaigns.
sents.cn: 明确的规则和持续投入，比一次性活动更重要。

sents.en: Schools can build lifelong learning into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra.

sents.en: Government can fund public facilities so that lifelong learning is not limited to those who can pay.

The earlier scene features a peaceful natural landscape, whereas the later one shows crowded tourist facilities, numerous boats and scattered rubbish. The contrast highlights the environmental cost of poorly managed tourism.

sents.en: The pictures above present a striking contrast between a scenic area in the past and the same place today.
sents.cn: 以上两幅图呈现了某景区过去与今天的鲜明反差。

sents.en: The earlier scene features a peaceful natural landscape, whereas the later one shows crowded tourist facilities, numerous boats and scattered rubbish.
sents.cn: 早先的画面是宁静的自然景观，而如今却是拥挤的旅游设施、众多游船和散落的垃圾。

sents.en: The contrast highlights the environmental cost of poorly managed tourism.
sents.cn: 这一反差凸显了管理不善的旅游业所付出的环境代价。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. Primary among these is that rising environmental awareness has turned tourism into a mark of responsible living. Equally important, some providers put immediate profit first, which leaves quality and safety poorly managed. A further driver is that rules have not kept pace with how quickly tourism has spread.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象是多种因素共同作用的结果。

sents.en: Primary among these is that rising environmental awareness has turned tourism into a mark of responsible living.
sents.cn: 首要的是，环保意识的提升，使 旅游 成为负责任生活的标志。

sents.en: Equally important, some providers put immediate profit first, which leaves quality and safety poorly managed.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，一些商家把眼前利润放在首位，导致质量与安全疏于管理。

sents.en: A further driver is that rules have not kept pace with how quickly tourism has spread.
sents.cn: 另一个推动因素是，规则的更新速度，赶不上 旅游 扩散的速度。

blocks.v: On balance, the two pictures point to a problem worth taking seriously. Authorities should set clear limits and make sure they are actually enforced. Platforms should label or restrict content that encourages misuse. Media should report the real risks rather than treat them as scare stories. Unless effective measures are taken, it may well get worse.

sents.en: On balance, the two pictures point to a problem worth taking seriously.
sents.cn: 总体来看，这两幅画指向一个不容忽视的问题。

sents.en: Authorities should set clear limits and make sure they are actually enforced.
sents.cn: 政府应设定明确的上限，并确保真正执行。

sents.en: Platforms should label or restrict content that encourages misuse.
sents.cn: 平台应对诱导滥用的内容加以标注或限制。

sents.en: Media should report the real risks rather than treat them as scare stories.
sents.cn: 媒体应报道真实风险，而不是把它当成吓人的故事。

sents.en: Unless effective measures are taken, it may well get worse.
sents.cn: 若不采取有效措施，情况很可能进一步恶化。
